fields.position: Center of the visible flower petals or bud body, for particle emission.
fields.attachmentPosition: Original flower/bud object origin at the twig attachment.
fields.direction: Unit vector along the flower/bud growth axis.
fields.rotation: Quaternion [x, y, z, w]; local +Y points along direction.

transformNote: Coordinates align with magnolia-branches.glb at its original transform. Apply the same parent/world matrix to emitters if the tree is moved, rotated or scaled.
